title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Servicing Standard: Payments Returned Unpaid
content:
**Reversal.** When the cardmember's bank returns a payment to a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account unpaid, the payment's credit is reversed with a returned-payment entry pointing to the original payment by its transaction reference, and that payment no longer counts toward any minimum payment.

**Fee.** A returned payment fee is assessed as a fee entry of the returned payment fee type, equal to the lower of the card's returned payment fee and the minimum payment due on the statement immediately before the return.

**When no fee is assessed.** No returned payment fee is assessed when a late fee was already assessed for the same missed minimum payment, because one event may not draw both fees; and none is assessed when the returned payment was itself made after the due date it would have satisfied.

**Condition on a reversal.** The payment returned has not been reversed before: the account's transaction records show no earlier returned-payment entry pointing to the same payment.

## Fee in figures (hypothetical amounts; card returned payment fee USD 29.00)

| Minimum payment due on the statement before the return | Late fee already assessed for the same missed minimum | Payment made after the due date it would have satisfied | Returned payment fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| USD 55.00 | no | no | USD 29.00 |
| USD 22.00 | no | no | USD 22.00 |
| USD 55.00 | yes | no | none |
| USD 55.00 | no | yes | none |

## Points of judgement

- *The bank returns a payment that already carries a returned-payment entry.* The payment has been reversed before, so it is not reversed again.
- *A returned payment had been counted toward a minimum payment.* Once returned, it no longer counts toward any minimum payment.
